mapper.select: SELECT TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, join_time, leave_time) as time_interval, COUNT(*) as user_count FROM audience_record WHERE live_room_id = #{liveRoomId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY time_interval ORDER BY time_interval ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM audience_record WHERE live_room_id = #{liveRoomId} AND is_deleted = 0
